examples.text: Du bist in letzter Zeit sehr obliviös, meine Liebe.

glosses: Unable to remember things well; liable to forget.

examples.text: Nor has Dalua part or mention in the antique legend. Like other ancient things, this divinity hath come secretly upon us in a forgetful time, new and strange and terrible, though his unremembered shadow crossed our way when first we set out on our long travel, in the youth of the world.

glosses: Dropping some of the input's structure or properties before producing an output.

examples.text: a forgetful mapping; a forgetful functor
